traditional: the Moon trine Jupiter: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports growth, fortune, and patronage — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet optimism and expansion. A resilient inner buoyancy that recovers no matter what, plus real generosity. The trine makes this a natural strength: Emotional warmth and an instinct to give. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Feeling and growth flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and growth have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
